sentences.text: Elise Neal -LRB- born March 14 , 1966 -RRB- is an American actress .
Her big break came in 1997 , appearing in films Rosewood , Money Talks and Scream 2 .	Rosewood	Rosewood (film)	Money Talks	Money Talks (1997 film)	Scream 2	Scream 2

Restaurant	Restaurant (1998 film)	Mission to Mars	Mission to Mars	Paid in Full	Paid in Full (2002 film)	Hustle & Flow	Hustle & Flow	Logan	Logan (film)
